```
repo <project> default [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--group` | Limit to a repository group. |
| `--repo` | Limit to one repository. |
| `--select` | Selection expression. |
| `--dry-run` | Preview; make no changes. |
| `--yes`, `-y` | Skip the confirmation prompt. |
| `--ignore-skips` | Exit 0 even when repos are safety-skipped. |
| `--stash` | For dirty repos: stash, switch and fast-forward, then restore. |
| `--jobs` | Parallel workers for fetches. |
| `--json` | Emit JSON instead of a table. |
| `--help` | Show this message and exit. |
